SELECT (oi.product_snapshot->>'productId')::bigint as productId, (oi.product_snapshot->>'name') as productName, SUM(oi.quantity) as totalSold, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price), 0) as revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') AND o.created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL GROUP BY (oi.product_snapshot->>'productId')::bigint, (oi.product_snapshot->>'name') ORDER BY totalSold DESC LIMIT #{limit}
